settings.title: Settings
settings.demoModeHint: Shows a simulated heading for demonstration only. Real compass readings are off while this is on.
settings.northHint: True north adds the local magnetic declination. It needs a location fix; without one, set it by hand below.
settings.offsetHint: Corrects the phone's own magnetometer bias. Wave a figure 8, align with a physical compass, then trim here.
settings.declinationManualHint: If there is no fix, set it by hand. Türkiye is roughly +4…+7° east.

compass.simulated: DEMO MODE — simulated heading, not a real measurement
compass.noMagnetometerBody: This phone has no magnetometer, so it cannot measure direction. That is a hardware limitation, not an app error.
compass.noMagnetometerStillWorks: The level, location and sunrise/sunset readings below still work.
compass.levelHint: Hold the phone flat for best results
compass.declinationNoFix: True north needs a location fix
compass.interference: Magnetic interference — move away from metal and magnets
compass.suspectField: Field weak or strong — the reading may drift
compass.figureEight: Calibrate by waving the phone in a figure 8
